centered.description: Shows a midpoint tick and fills from that point to a single thumb.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code used with currency format.

disabled.description: Makes the slider unavailable for pointer, keyboard and form submission.

format.description: Display format for the readout and accessible values.

help-text.description: Optional supporting text, read as the description of each thumb.

label.description: Visible base name. Use a task-specific, localized label.

marks.description: Number of evenly spaced tick intervals, up to 100. Zero hides ticks.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound. A maximum below min collapses the scale.

maximum-label.description: Localized suffix for the upper thumb's accessible name.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound and step origin.

minimum-label.description: Localized suffix for the lower thumb's accessible name.

name.description: Native form key. Omit when the value should remain local to the control.

orientation.description: Axis of the scale. A vertical scale increases towards the top.

range.description: Enables two non-crossing thumbs in minimum then maximum tab order.

step.description: Positive increment. Values snap from min and max is always reachable.

value.description:
Current selection as a number or, in range mode, a comma-separated pair.
HTML attributes also accept the scalar as numeric text. Defaults to min
for one thumb and to both bounds for a range. User updates are normalized.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-slider-coarse-target.description: Minimum target size on a coarse pointer.

--ki-slider-fill-backdrop-filter.description: Optional effect behind the active rail.

--ki-slider-fill-bg.description: Colour of the active section of the rail.

--ki-slider-fill-bg-image.description: Optional image painted on the active rail.

--ki-slider-gap.description: Gap between the slider control and its labels.

--ki-slider-radius.description: Round rail, grip and midpoint tick corners.

--ki-slider-text-bg.description: Background beneath the value readout and help.

--ki-slider-text-fg.description: Ink of the value readout and help.

--ki-slider-thumb-bg-image.description: Optional image painted on the grip.

--ki-slider-thumb-border.description: Outline colour of the visible grip.

--ki-slider-thumb-border-width.description: Outline thickness of the visible grip.

--ki-slider-thumb-size.description: Diameter of the visible grip within the pointer target.

--ki-slider-track-backdrop-filter.description: Optional effect behind the inactive rail.

--ki-slider-track-bg.description: Inactive rail colour against the surrounding surface.

--ki-slider-track-bg-image.description: Optional image painted on the inactive rail.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: Adjusts a value or an interval on a bounded scale.

change.description:
Bubbles once when a pointer operation commits a different
selection or a keyboard action changes it. Read the current host value.
For updates during a drag, listen for the standard bubbling `input` event.
Programmatic updates and form resets are silent.

center-tick.description: Midpoint mark on a centered scale.

field.description: Layout containing the visible label, value, controls and help.

help.description: Supporting text associated with each thumb.

label.description: Visible text used to name the control.

mark.description: Decorative scale mark at an interval boundary.

thumb.description: Focusable pointer target for one end of the selection.

track.description: Inactive rail between the two ends of the scale.

value.description: Formatted value or interval shown beside the label.
